title: Unmatched: Digital Edition
description:
Command the ultimate battle between unlikely fighters! Unmatched: Digital Edition is an adaptation of the critically acclaimed board game, where two to four players command characters from myth, history, or fiction in a battle for the ages! 

Have you ever wondered who would win between King Arthur and a sword-wielding Alice of Wonderland? How would Sinbad and his trusty porter fare against Medusa and the three harpies? The only way to find the truth is in battle with a quick game of Unmatched!

The Dire Wolf relaunch of Unmatched: Digital Edition is a new version of the game built from the ground up with fluid animations that bring the iconic miniatures and tabletop artwork to life. New features include an updated tutorial, new CPU opponents, and a diverse Challenge system, with more to come in the future!

Players on Steam will be able to jump into this beta version of Unmatched on July 29th, to be followed by a full release in the coming months. During that time, we’ll be interested in hearing your feedback! The beta period is a time for you to let us know what’s working and what could be improved. Notice any bugs or issues? Think the CPU opponents could use some tweaking? Don’t hesitate to pass your thoughts along!

Battle Across the AgesUnmatched: Digital Edition is a fast-paced tactical dueling game where legendary heroes face off in battles across the ages. Each player controls a hero, their sidekick(s), and a unique deck of cards built around that character’s fighting style and abilities.

• Maneuver to move your fighters and draw a card

• Attack by playing an attack card

• Scheme to trigger special effects and clever tricks

Reduce the opposing hero’s health to zero to claim victory!

No two fighters feel alike. Alice can shift between growing giant and shrinking small. King Arthur strengthens attacks by sacrificing cards from his hand. Sinbad becomes more dangerous the farther his voyages take him. Medusa can wound enemies with a single deadly stare.

Simple rules. Wildly different heroes. Endless matchups!

Includes6 Heroes

• Sinbad

• Medusa

• King Arthur

• Alice

• Little Red

• Beowulf

3 Battlegrounds

• Sarpedon

• Maroreal

• Heorot

Game Modes• Vs AI 

• Online Lobby Play

• Challenges
